procedures.doc: Returns the G/L Register that has been created during the posting process.

procedures.name: RunWithCheck
procedures.doc: Wrapper for the main procedure which checks and posts the journal line. As a result G/L Entries and Register are created along with other related ledger entries.

procedures.name: RunWithoutCheck
procedures.doc: Wrapper for the main procedure posts the journal line without checking it. As a result G/L Entries and Register are created along with other related ledger entries.

procedures.name: IsGLEntryInconsistent
procedures.doc: Specifies if the General Ledger Entries that have been created during the posting process are inconsistent.

procedures.name: ShowInconsistentEntries
procedures.doc: Shows a list of all inconsistent G/L Entries that has been produced during the posting.

procedures.name: InitLastDocDate
procedures.doc: Assignes information (Document Type, Document No., Posting Date) fron Gen. Journal Line to the global variables.

procedures.name: InitVAT
procedures.doc: Initializes the G/L Entry for posting VAT depending on the VAT Posting of the Gen. Journal Line.

procedures.name: PostVAT
procedures.doc: Creates and inserts VAT Entries for the Gen. Journal Line that is being posted. If Gen. Journal Line requires Sales Tax, VAT Entries are created and inserted for each Tax Line that is needed.

procedures.name: InsertVAT
procedures.doc: Creates and inserts VAT Entry for the Gen. Journal Line that is being posted. If Calculation Type is Sales Tax, VAT Entries are filled with Tax related information. VAT Posting Parameter is created to be used for the VAT Entry.

procedures.name: SummarizeVAT
procedures.doc: Creates G/L Entries for VAT. If summarization is needed, before creating new entry existing ones in TempGLEntryVAT. buffer are checked. If entry in the buffer for the same G/L Account and Bal. Account already exists, just the amount is increased.

procedures.name: InsertSummarizedVAT
procedures.doc: Inserts summarized VAT G/L Entries for the Gen. Journal Line that is being posted. Summarized entries are taken from TempGLEntryVAT buffer.

procedures.name: RunPostFixedAsset
procedures.doc: Wrapper procedure for external call of PostFixedAssetPostFixedAsset, which is used for posting a Gen. Journal Line with Account Type Fixed Asset. G/L Entries, VAT Entries and FA Ledger Entries are created.

procedures.name: PostJob
procedures.doc: Wrapper procedure for external call of PostJob, which is used for posting a gen. journal line with account type job. G/l entries, job entries, usage related ledger entries (resourse or item and value), possibly warehouse entries are created.

procedures.name: StartPosting
procedures.doc: Initialize global variables and G/L Register for new posting batch, locks needed tables.

procedures.name: ContinuePosting
procedures.doc: If new transaction needs to be started, Unrealized VAT is check and posted, global values initialized for the new transaction. Currency is updated for the new Gen. Journal Line that is being posted, current Balance of the posting is updated.

procedures.name: ResetTransactionState
procedures.doc: Invalidates the transaction-scoped caches in this codeunit so the next call to RunWithCheck is forced through StartPosting (which re-takes the G/L Entry table lock and re-reads the last entry number from disk) instead of taking the ContinuePosting fast path with a stale NextEntryNo.

procedures.name: FinishPosting
procedures.doc: Checks if transaction is balanced for both local and additional currencies, inserts all G/L Entries that were created for the Gen. Journal Line. procedures.name: InitGLEntry
procedures.doc: Initializes g/l entry from gen. journal line.

procedures.name: InitGLEntryVAT
procedures.doc: Initializes g/l entry from gen. journal line and summarizes VAT g/l entries.

procedures.name: InitGLEntryVATCopy
procedures.doc: Initializes a general ledger entry for VAT posting with data copied from an existing VAT entry. Creates G/L entry with dimension and posting details derived from the source VAT entry.

procedures.name: InsertGLEntry
procedures.doc: Updates the amounts of the g/l entry and adds it to the TempGLEntryBuffer to be inserted.

procedures.name: CreateGLEntry
procedures.doc: Initializes the g/l entry from the general journal line and adds it to the TempGLEntryBuffer to be inserted.

procedures.name: CreateGLEntryBalAcc
procedures.doc: Initializes the g/l entry from the general journal line. Fills balance account information and adds it to the TempGLEntryBuffer to be inserted.

procedures.name: CreateGLEntryVAT
procedures.doc: Initializes the g/l entry from the general journal line and detailed cv. ledger entry buffer, adds the g/l entry to the TempGLEntryBuffer to be inserted. Inserts vat entries.

procedures.name: CreateGLEntryVATCollectAdj
procedures.doc: Initializes the g/l entry from the general journal line and detailed cv. ledger entry buffer, adds the g/l entry to the TempGLEntryBuffer to be inserted. Collects needed adjustments, inserts vat entries.

procedures.name: CalcAmtLCYAdjustment
procedures.doc: Calculates the difference in local currency between the actual remaining amount of the c/v ledger entry and the remaining amount based on the adjusted currency factor. If there is a difference then detailed CV ledger entries are created and posted to equate the difference.

procedures.name: ApplyCustLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Prepares and posts customer ledger entries needed for the application. Detailed customer ledger entries are created and posted for both the old and the new customer ledger entry.

procedures.name: CustPostApplyCustLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Stand-alone procedure to post (from check to finish) application gen. journal line for the customer ledger entries. G/l entries, vat entries, customer ledger entries and detailed customer ledger entries are created and posted.

procedures.name: PostDtldCustLedgEntries
procedures.doc: Posts all detailed customer ledger entries that are stored in DtldCVLedgEntryBuf. Creates g/l entry for the total amounts.

procedures.name: ApplyVendLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Prepares and posts vendor ledger entries needed for the application. Detailed vendor ledger entries are created and posted for both the old and the new vendor ledger entry.

procedures.name: ApplyEmplLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Prepares and posts employee ledger entries needed for the application. Detailed employee ledger entries are created and posted for both the old and the new employee ledger entry.

procedures.name: VendPostApplyVendLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Stand-alone procedure to post (from check to finish) application gen. journal line for the vendor ledger entries. G/l entries, vat entries, vendor ledger entries and detailed vendor ledger entries are created and posted.

procedures.name: EmplPostApplyEmplLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Stand-alone procedure to post (from check to finish) application gen. journal line for the employee ledger entries. G/l entries, vat entries, employee ledger entries and detailed employee ledger entries are created and posted.

procedures.name: PostDtldVendLedgEntries
procedures.doc: Posts all detailed vendor ledger entries that are stored in DtldCVLedgEntryBuf. Creates g/l entry for the total amounts.

procedures.name: PostDtldEmplLedgEntries
procedures.doc: Posts all detailed employee ledger entries that are stored in DtldCVLedgEntryBuf. Creates g/l entry for the total amounts.

procedures.name: PostDtldCVLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Depending on the detailed customer/vendor ledger entry type, creates g/l entry and other entries for the detailed customer/vendor ledger entry. If general journal line is created not for the unapplication purpose, adjustments can be collected.

procedures.name: PostUnrealVATEntry
procedures.doc: Posts an unrealized VAT entry for general journal line processing. Handles unrealized VAT scenarios where VAT is posted upon payment rather than invoice.

procedures.name: PostApply
procedures.doc: Posts application entry to and applies it to the already existing customer/vendor/employee ledger entry. In the process g/l entries and detailed entries are created, existing customer/vendor/employee ledger entries are updated.

procedures.name: UnapplyCustLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Creates and posts un-applying entry for currently applied detailed customer ledger entry. G/l entry with unapplied amount is created as part of the process Related customer ledger entry is being updated as part of the process Unrealized vat is posted

procedures.name: UnapplyVendLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Creates and posts un-applying entry for currently applied detailed vendor ledger entry. G/l entry with unapplied amount is created as part of the process Related vendor ledger entry is being updated as part of the process Unrealized vat is posted

procedures.name: UnapplyEmplLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Creates and posts un-applying entry for currently applied detailed employee ledger entry. G/l entry with unapplied amount is created as part of the process Related employee ledger entry is being updated as part of the process

procedures.name: PmtTolCust
procedures.doc: Validates payment tolerance for customer ledger entries and shows tolerance warning if needed. Calculates tolerance amounts and displays confirmation dialog for tolerance processing.

procedures.name: PmtTolGenJnl
procedures.doc: Validates payment tolerance for general journal line payments. Determines if tolerance warnings should be shown for customer and vendor payments.

procedures.name: PmtTolPmtReconJnl
procedures.doc: Processes payment tolerance for bank account reconciliation lines. Determines whether payment tolerance should be applied based on account type.

procedures.name: CallPmtDiscTolWarning
procedures.doc: Displays payment discount tolerance warning dialog and handles user response. Calculates whether payment discount tolerance should be applied based on user choice.

procedures.name: CallPmtTolWarning
procedures.doc: Displays payment tolerance warning dialog and processes user response. Allows user to accept or reject payment tolerance amounts for transactions.

procedures.name: CalcGracePeriodCVLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Calculates and updates payment tolerance grace period for all open customer and vendor ledger entries. Processes entries that fall within the specified grace period for payment tolerance.

procedures.name: CalcTolCustLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Calculates payment tolerance for customer ledger entries. Updates customer ledger entries with payment tolerance amounts based on General Ledger setup and currency configuration.

procedures.name: DelTolCustLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Deletes payment tolerance settings for customer ledger entries. Resets payment tolerance amount and maximum payment tolerance to zero for the specified customer.

procedures.name: CalcTolVendLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Calculates payment tolerance for vendor ledger entries. Updates vendor ledger entries with payment tolerance amounts based on General Ledger setup and currency configuration.

procedures.name: DelTolVendLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Deletes payment tolerance settings for vendor ledger entries. Resets payment tolerance amount and maximum payment tolerance to zero for the specified vendor.

procedures.name: DelPmtTolApllnDocNo
procedures.doc: Deletes payment tolerance for applications with the specified document number. Removes tolerance settings from customer or vendor ledger entries based on account type in the general journal line.

procedures.name: ABSMinTol
procedures.doc: Returns the decimal value with minimum absolute value considering tolerance. Compares two decimal values and returns the one with the smaller absolute value after applying tolerance.

procedures.name: GetApplicationRoundingPrecisionForAppliesToDoc
procedures.doc: Gets application rounding precision for applies-to document currency operations. Determines rounding precision values based on applied entry and application currency codes.

procedures.name: GetAmountRoundingPrecision
procedures.doc: Gets amount rounding precision for multi-currency applications. Determines application and amount rounding precision based on currency and multi-currency settings.

procedures.name: CalcRemainingPmtDisc
procedures.doc: Calculates remaining payment discount for CV ledger entry buffers. Updates payment discount amounts and remaining payment discount possible fields based on application scenarios.

procedures.name: CalcMaxPmtTolerance
procedures.doc: Calculates maximum payment tolerance for a document. Determines payment tolerance amount based on document type, currency, amount, and General Ledger setup configuration.

procedures.name: CheckCalcPmtDiscCVCust
procedures.doc: Checks and calculates payment discount for CV ledger entry buffer against customer ledger entry. Validates payment discount eligibility between CV buffer and customer entries.

procedures.name: CheckCalcPmtDiscCust
procedures.doc: Checks and calculates payment discount between customer ledger entries. Validates payment discount eligibility between new and existing customer ledger entries.

procedures.name: CheckCalcPmtDiscGenJnlCust
procedures.doc: Checks and calculates payment discount for general journal line against customer ledger entry. Validates payment discount eligibility between journal line and customer entry.

procedures.name: CheckCalcPmtDiscCVVend

procedures.name: CheckCalcPmtDiscGenJnlVend
procedures.doc: Checks and calculates payment discount for general journal line against vendor ledger entry. Validates payment discount eligibility between journal line and vendor entry.

procedures.name: CheckAccountType
